name: Carnevale et al. 2022 screen, T-cell resistance to tumour-microenvironment inhibitory signals
description: Perturbation screen identifying genes that render T cells resistant to inhibitory signals.

attributes.version: As replayed by the cited benchmark from the original screen
attributes.assay: Pooled CRISPR perturbation screen with a phenotypic readout
attributes.scope_note: Replayed offline: the benchmark looks up the measured phenotypic response of each selected gene instead of running a new experiment. Genes the screen did not assay are absent from the candidate pool, so they are neither hits nor non-hits.
attributes.source_locator: Roohani et al. 2025 section 4.1; Gupta et al. 2025 appendix B.1.1

positives.note: Roohani et al. do not print the hit count or the threshold tau per screen; Gupta et al. print their own ground-truth hit counts, recorded as a claim on their protocol

total.note: Stated as 'over 18,000 genes' rather than an exact count
